device.description: 16-bit low-noise buffered voltage-output DAC with SPI interface, read-back, LDAC, reset and power-down pins
device.note: dac8881.pdf (SBAS422B) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 electrical characteristics (IOVDD), p.7-8 timing characteristics, p.9-11 timing diagrams (Figures 1-3), p.28-29 input data format, hardware reset, power-on reset, reset value, power down, LDAC, p.30 serial interface (stand-alone and daisy-chain modes)

registers.name: IN
registers.note: input register; power-on/RST 0000h with RSTSEL low (p.29 Table 3)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC latch; power-on/RST 0000h with RSTSEL low

registers.name: MODE
registers.note: internal: level of the SDOSEL pin (1 = stand-alone read-back, 0 = daisy-chain), p.3, p.30

commands.name: Load input register
commands.note: p.30: 16 or more bits on SCLK rising; the last 16 go to the input register at CS rising; fewer than 16 bits = invalid frame

protocol.note: p.30 stand-alone mode (SDOSEL high): SDO shifts out the existing input register, then zeros; daisy-chain mode (SDOSEL low): SDO is the shift register output

pages: p.3 (pinout, pin functions), p.4 (AVDD 2.7-5.5 V, IOVDD 1.7 V-AVDD), p.6 (logic levels), p.8 (SDO timing t10 15 ns, t11 20 ns, t13 8 ns at DVDD < 3.6 V), p.9-11 (Figures 1-3: SCLK low at CS falling, data in on rising edges), p.28-29 (Tables 1-3, reset, power down, LDAC), p.30 (serial interface)
notModeled: analog: buffered voltage output, Kelvin reference inputs, output gain (GAIN pin), RFB
USB/BTC selects straight binary or two's complement input coding; the stored code is unaffected (only the analog output mapping changes)
PDN power-down (output to AGND through 10 kOhm; registers and SPI stay active) has no digital effect and is not modeled
daisy-chain SDO (SDOSEL low): SDO is the input shift register output, 16 clocks behind SDI; the model drives SDO low in that mode
stand-alone read-back with more than 16 clocks: the model shifts the input register then zeros, as the datasheet describes; fewer than 16 bits = invalid frame (ignored)
